text:
maya_pd: Quick sync — one enterprise prospect asked for a one-page pilot addendum + a greenlight checklist before we send DP invites. Main concerns: residency, retention, incident comms, and an explicit upgrade path.

tom_legal: I can produce a short addendum. Prefer plain-language bullets: uptime target, deletion SLA, telemetry access, fallback behavior. Any required crypto/HSM notes?

ravi_solutions: They mentioned 99.9% but said they're flexible. Proposal: pilot default = 99.5% hosted, 30-day retention. Offer paid upgrades: 99.9% reserved pool, and 90/365d retention tiers.

hana_ops: Ops reality: hosted = 99.5% achievable. 99.9% needs reserved capacity. Planned maint windows: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sev1 ack <= 1h, daily updates until resolved.

kevin_eng: Tech: KV cache purge within 72h on written request; conversational logs deletion available. Aggregated dashboards by default; raw request exports only with explicit opt-in + data-handling addendum. Fallback: route to compatible model variant or apply temporary throttles; we'll notify partner with an expected remediation timeline.

maya_pd: Let's split must-haves vs negotiables in the invite. Must-haves = 99.5% pilot uptime, 30d default retention, 72h deletion SLA, dashboard access, 1h Sev1 ack. Negotiables = raw logs, 99.9% SLA, longer retention.

dp-helper: Reminder: use dp-invite-onepager v2 at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dp-invite-onepager as the base template.

tom_legal: Draft snippet for review: 
"SLA (Pilot addendum): Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide 99.5% monthly uptime for hosted pilot endpoints. Data retention: default 30 days; customer-initiated deletion of KV cache and conversational logs will be completed within 72 hours of written request, except as required by law. Telemetry: aggregated metrics and latency dashboards provided; raw request logs available only with explicit consent and a separate data-handling addendum. Failover: Redwood may route traffic to a compatible model variant or apply temporary rate limits during capacity or safety events; Redwood will notify partner and provide a remediation timeline."

ravi_solutions: Add launch acceptance criteria line: latency p95 < 500ms, quality regression <= 3% on partner eval set, uptime >= 99.5% during pilot window. Include 5 sample prompts in the invite for quick sanity check.

hana_ops: I'll confirm maintenance cadence and add weekly usage summary export (no raw logs by default).

kevin_eng: For private/dedicated deployments we'll add: "Upgrade to dedicated reserved pool available under separate agreement with 99.9% SLA."

maya_pd: Action items: tom = addendum redline + checklist (NDA, onboarding call, sample prompts, eval set, POC), hana = ops windows + export cadence, kevin = tech appendix for deletion & upgrade path, ravi = partner-facing talking points + 5-prompt eval. Aim to send invites next Tuesday. Reconvene if partner asks for enterprise SOW. :white_check_mark:
